name: khazix-human-writing
description: Creates and revises grounded Chinese writing with natural rhythm and a distinct human voice.

displayDescription.en: Starts from source material and factual boundaries, then writes or revises Chinese prose with natural rhythm, concrete detail, clear judgment, and none of the usual model voice.
displayDescription.zh: 先核材料与事实边界，再完成中文创作和改稿，清理重复、报告腔与模型腔，让文字像一个具体的人在说话

defaultInitPrompt.en: Use Human Writing to turn my materials into a grounded Chinese piece that sounds like a real person.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 使用活人感写作，把我的材料写成一篇有事实支撑、读起来像具体的人在说话的作品

quickPrompts.en: Use Human Writing to turn my materials into a grounded Chinese piece that sounds like a real person.
quickPrompts.zh: 使用活人感写作，把我的材料写成一篇有事实支撑、读起来像具体的人在说话的作品

quickPrompts.en: Rewrite this AI-sounding Chinese draft so it reads naturally.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这篇 AI 味很重的中文稿改得自然一些

quickPrompts.en: Write a WeChat article from these verified materials.
quickPrompts.zh: 根据这些真实材料，写一篇有判断、有细节的公众号文章
